text: Nimra Qadir holds account PK**MEZN****9210 which was opened on 9 January 2021. The subject is a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month. During the activity window 2 May 2026 to 30 May 2026, there were 16 credits totalling PKR 24,648,000 and 6 debits totalling PKR 22,647,000. The account received 15 cash deposits totalling PKR 24,498,000 at four branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). An alert was raised by Tazama on 30 May 2026, with a typology score of 320 against a threshold of 300. Repeated cash deposits just below the reporting threshold are indicated by 13 of 15 deposits (87%) between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, totalling PKR 22,952,000, which is below the PKR 2,000,000 threshold. Deposits were spread across four branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch), consistent with the structuring hypothesis. There was more than one cash deposit on 22 May 2026, a pattern noted in the structuring typology. Credits were 164.3 times the declared monthly income of PKR 150,000 per month, suggesting cash volume inconsistent with declared income. These patterns are consistent with suspected structuring, given the high volume of cash deposits just below the threshold, spread across branches, and the large discrepancy with declared income. PKR 11,807,000 was sent to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank A) in 3 transactions. PKR 10,840,000 was sent to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank C) in 3 transactions. Debits equal 92% of credits, with a median of 28.1 hours between the latest credit and each debit. Screening on 28 May 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media lists. Account placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision; no contact made with the customer about this review.
